messages.subject: R/qtl2 version 0.8
messages.body_plain:
[Oops that last post had an unfortunate error in the code.]

For those interested in R/qtl2 <http://kbroman.org/qtl2>, there's a new version (0.8) with some major changes. We've merged the separate packages qtl2geno, qtl2scan, qtl2plot, and qtl2db into a single package, qtl2 <https://github.com/rqtl/qtl2>. The function names are all the same, just rolled into a single package.

The qtl2convert package (for converting objects among the R/qtl, DOQTL, and R/qtl2 formats) remains a separate package.

To remove the old packages: remove.packages(paste0("qtl2", c("geno", "scan", "plot", "db")))

To install the new R/qtl2 package: install.packages("qtl2", repos="https://rqtl.org/qtl2cran")

The user guide <http://kbroman.org/qtl2/assets/vignettes/user_guide.html> and other documentation <http://kbroman.org/qtl2/docs> have been revised to reflect the changes.

karl

messages.subject: R/qtl2 version 0.10
messages.body_plain:
Just released yet another version of R/qtl2 (version 0.10).

(Oops again. Found a bad bug in find_peaks().)

To update, use:

    update.packages(repos="https://rqtl.org/qtl2cran")

Or install from scratch:

    install.packages("qtl2", repos="https://rqtl.org/qtl2cran")

karl
